name: lv_obj_tree_walk

ownership.argument: Root, callback and user_data are borrowed synchronously; a null root selects all registered screens on all displays.
ownership.return_value: Integer walk result; callback 0 continues, 1 skips children, 2 ends the current rooted traversal. Null-root dispatcher does not propagate early termination across all screens and returns 2 after its display loop.
ownership.callback_argument: Live object and user_data borrowed only for the synchronous invocation; do not mutate the walked tree or retain unchecked pointers.

provenance.source: Exact .155 AP instruction/call-site inspection plus source-compiled Unicorn probes in Canopus-Module-Resource-Hook/tests/firmware_reload.py; see companion evidence for byte-window hashes.

notes: Null-root branch traverses display list at 0x200bd1e8+12 and display screens/count at +692/+720. Nonnull branch calls child accessor 0x0c380320 and count 0x0c380342. Callbacks must not mutate/delete the traversed tree. Resource Hook uses read-only bounded collection/membership callbacks, caps parent depth and object count, and performs mutations only after traversal returns. Actual walk/accessor instructions are exercised against modeled trees. UI-owner thread only, outside IRQ lock. Host emulation is not a physical device probe or an approval for general veneer generation.
